plan:
- Design and simulate a high-frequency resonant transformer coil (primary and secondary).
- Select a high-voltage, high-frequency power supply and a robust spark gap or solid-state switching circuit.
- Construct a large air-core helical coil (secondary) and a smaller primary coil, ensuring proper insulation.
- Fabricate a sturdy, non-conductive mechanical frame to support the coils, top load, and associated electronics.
- Implement a grounding system and safety interlocks for high-voltage operation.
- Develop a control system for power regulation and tuning, potentially using a microcontroller (e.g., Arduino or ESP32) to manage switching frequency and duration.

nodes.name: Main Controller
nodes.description: Compact microcontroller for safety monitoring and basic system control.

nodes.name: High Voltage Power Supply
nodes.description: Step-up transformer providing high voltage AC for the primary circuit.

nodes.name: Input Power Variac
nodes.description: Adjustable AC transformer to control the input voltage and power level.

nodes.name: Primary Capacitor Bank
nodes.description: Bank of capacitors storing energy for discharge into the primary coil.

nodes.name: Static Spark Gap
nodes.description: Adjustable electrodes that break down and conduct high voltage, initiating oscillation.

nodes.name: Main Power Control Relay
nodes.description: Switches AC power to the HVPS based on MCU commands and safety interlocks.

nodes.name: Emergency Stop Button
nodes.description: Normally closed switch to immediately cut power for safety.
nodes.productName: Mushroom Head Emergency Stop Switch NO/NC

nodes.name: Safety Key Switch
nodes.description: Key-operated switch to arm/disarm the system, preventing accidental operation.

nodes.name: Ballast Inductor
nodes.description: Limits current from the HVPS to prevent damage during spark gap firing.

nodes.name: Acrylic Base Plate
nodes.description: Non-conductive base for mounting all components.

nodes.name: PVC Secondary Coil Form
nodes.description: Insulating form for winding the secondary coil.

nodes.name: Acrylic Support Rods
nodes.description: Supports for the secondary coil assembly and safety enclosure.

nodes.name: Non-Conductive Top Load Rod
nodes.description: Insulating rod connecting the spherical top load to the secondary coil.

nodes.name: Stainless Steel Top Load Sphere
nodes.description: Capacitive terminal at the top of the secondary coil for enhanced output.

nodes.name: Acrylic Safety Panels
nodes.description: Transparent panels to enclose the high-voltage components for safety.

nodes.name: M3 Nylon Standoffs
nodes.description: Insulating standoffs for mounting PCBs and other small components.

nodes.name: M3 Screws and Nuts
nodes.description: General purpose fasteners for assembling mechanical and electrical components.

nodes.name: M4 Screws and Nuts
nodes.description: Heavier duty fasteners for mounting larger components like the variac or HVPS.

nodes.name: HVPS Mounting Bracket
nodes.description: Custom bracket to securely mount the High Voltage Power Supply.

nodes.name: Variac Mounting Bracket
nodes.description: Custom bracket to securely mount the Input Power Variac.

nodes.name: Capacitor Bank Mount
nodes.description: Mounting bracket for the Primary Capacitor Bank.

nodes.name: MCU Enclosure/Mount
nodes.description: Small enclosure to protect and mount the Main Controller (Arduino Nano).

nodes.name: Adjustable Spark Gap Mount
nodes.description: Mount with adjustment mechanism for the static spark gap electrodes.

nodes.name: Primary Coil Support Ring
nodes.description: Insulating ring to support the primary coil windings around the secondary coil base.

nodes.name: Secondary Coil Base Mount
nodes.description: Mount for securing the PVC secondary coil form to the base plate.

nodes.name: Secondary Coil Top Mount
nodes.description: Mount for attaching the top load rod to the top of the secondary coil form.

nodes.name: Control Panel Mounts
nodes.description: Mounts for the E-stop and Key Switch on an enclosure panel.

projectDescription: A desktop Tesla magnifying transmitter generates high voltage for wireless power experiments. Utilizing a static spark gap and a high voltage power supply, it drives a resonant air-core coil with a spherical top-load, all safely enclosed on an acrylic base.

tools: Multimeter with high voltage probe (for testing)
Drill and drill bits (for acrylic and PVC)
Hot glue gun or appropriate adhesive
assumptions: Basic electronics knowledge and soldering experience
Familiarity with Arduino IDE for microcontroller programming
Understanding of high voltage safety procedures
Access to AC mains power for the variac and HVPS
